name: pi-lmstudio-evict
description: Pi extension for LM Studio: on /model switch it unloads the old model and preloads the new one, so only one model holds your VRAM. Reloads models evicted by idle TTL, covers what Auto-Evict misses, and keeps models.json in sync.
